description: Register a booking request for the passenger (name, email, phone required; only with the user's explicit consent). Returns a reference and a prefilled booking_url where the passenger confirms and pays (card or pay the driver).

date.description: Pickup date, YYYY-MM-DD (local time at pickup).

email.description: Lead passenger email; the booking confirmation is sent there.

from.description: Pickup: airport IATA code (CDG, ORY, BVA, LBG, OTP, NCE, LHR…), hotel name + city, or full address.

luggage.description: Number of suitcases, defaults to passengers (alias accepted: bags).

notes.description: Optional: child seat, extra stop, name sign text…

phone.description: Mobile in international format, e.g. +14155550123 (WhatsApp preferred).

return_date.description: Optional return date YYYY-MM-DD for a round trip.

time.description: Pickup time HH:MM 24h local. For airport pickups use the flight landing time.

to.description: Drop-off: airport IATA code, hotel name + city, or full address.

vehicle.description: Optional preferred vehicle: "E Class", "V Class", "S Class".

name: request_booking
title: Request a booking
